components.note: ⺼ (flesh/meat) — 腊 describes meat prepared as a sacrifice or preserved food.
昔 (former times, the past year) — meat ⺼ set aside for a sacrifice at year's end 昔 gave 腊 its meaning 'preserved meat,' and the name of the 12th lunar month.
艹 (plant) — the living thing in bloom.
化 (transformation) — the plant changing into blossom, the source of 花's meaning 'flower.'
囗 (an enclosure) — a garden like 园 is an enclosed area of land.
元 (yuán) gives the sound — an exact match with 园.
囗 (an enclosure) — 四 pictures a bounded space.
儿 (a person) — a person enclosed within four walls gave 四 its meaning 'four,' though the exact link to the number is debated.
夂 (a foot, to go) — 处 relates to arriving somewhere.
卜 (a mark or flag) — planting a marker after arriving gave 处 its meaning of 'a place' or 'to settle, deal with.'
讠 (speech) — 订 relates to arranging something through discussion or agreement.
丁 (dīng) gives a sound distantly related to dìng, having drifted apart over time.
女 (woman) — 婚 relates to marriage, historically centered on the wife.
昏 (hūn) gives the sound — an exact match with 婚.
谷 (valley) — 豁 relates to an open gap or breach, like a valley cutting through terrain.
害 (hài) gives a sound distantly related to 豁's reading huō, having drifted apart over time.
木 (wood) — 权 originally meant a wooden lever or weight, later extended to 'power, authority, right.'
雚 was historically closer to guàn; the pronunciation has since shifted to quán, so the sound link is faint today.
广 depicts a lean-to shelter built against a wall or cliff, open on one side — the image behind its meaning 'wide, spacious' and its use as the 'building' radical.
扌 (hand) — the hand doing the sowing.
番 (a field marked out into plots) — seeds scattered by hand across it, giving 播 its meaning 'to sow, to spread, to broadcast.'
西 is thought to depict a bird settling into its nest at dusk — since birds return to roost as the sun sets in the west, the character came to mean 'west.'
王 here is a variant of 玉 (jade), appearing once on each side of the character.
刂 (knife) — cutting a piece of jade in two, symbolizing a division into groups, gave 班 its meaning 'class, group.'
讠 (speech) — 语 relates to language, words, and speech
吾 (wú) gives a loose sound connection to 语's reading yǔ
戌 (a halberd/weapon) — represents armed force.
女 (woman) — force used to intimidate gave 威 its meaning 'power, might, awe-inspiring.'
心 (heart) — jealousy and dread are both feelings of the heart.
己 (jǐ) gives the sound — a close match for jì, sharing the initial and rhyme.
厂 (a cliff shape) reflects 厌's original meaning related to a rock formation, later shifted to mean "to dislike."
犬 (quǎn) gives a sound distantly related to yàn, having drifted apart over time.
亻 (person) shows this describes a person's state.
卷 depicts something curled or rolled up, like a tired person curling up to rest.
A drawing of a person standing with arms and legs spread wide — used to represent the idea of something being 'big' or 'great.'
声 (simplified from 聲) refers to sound; the traditional form combined several elements related to hearing and music, simplified here into a more compact shape.
大 (a person, arms outstretched) — represents a human being.
一 (a line, here representing the sky) — drawn above a person, showing what is above them: the heavens, hence 'sky, day.'
穴 (a cave/hole) — 空 relates to an empty hollow space.
工 (gōng) gives a hint of the sound — 空 is pronounced kōng, a connection that has drifted over time.
木 (tree) — provides the base image of a tree.
一 (a line) marks the base of the trunk, highlighting the roots — giving 本 its meaning 'root, origin, source.'
土 (earth/soil) — 地's original meaning is 'earth, ground'
也 (yě) gives a partial sound match for 地's other reading dì; in this grammatical-particle usage the character is instead pronounced 'de'
冫 pictures ice crystals forming.
水 (water) sits beside it, together showing water turned to ice.
⺮ (bamboo) — 箱 originally described a bamboo case or chest.
相 (xiāng) gives the sound — an exact match with 箱.

meanings: Long live (the king, the revolution etc)!
partner (in a business or other joint venture)

components.note: 亻 (person) — 伙 relates to people who share meals or work together.
火 (huǒ) gives the sound — an exact match with 伙's reading huǒ.
A simple line drawing of a person's legs seen from the side, used to depict a human being.
见 (to see) — relates directly to 视's meaning 'to look at, view.'
礻 (a form of 示, shì) gives the sound — 视 is also pronounced shì, an exact match.
氵 (water) — 治 relates to managing or controlling the flow of water, such as flood control.
台 (a platform, structure) — a structure used to direct and control water gave 治 its meaning 'to govern' or 'to manage.'
宀 (a roof, house) — 安 pictures shelter.
女 (woman) — a woman safely inside a house gave 安 its meaning 'peace' or 'safety.'
牙 (tooth) — teeth piercing or boring through something, the origin of 'to pierce'
穴 (xué) gives a sound distantly related to 穿's reading chuān, having drifted apart considerably over time
屮 (a young sprout) growing up and out of 凵 (a container or pit) — a picture of something emerging, hence 'going out.'
买 (to buy) — 卖 (to sell) is the flip side of buying, the other half of a transaction.
买 (mǎi) gives a sound very close to mài, differing only in tone.
木 (wood/tree) — 标 originally referred to the tip of a tree, later coming to mean 'mark, sign'
票 (piào) gives a sound close to 标's reading biāo
讠 (speech/writing) — the act of putting words down.
己 (oneself, private) — writing down one's own private notes or memories, giving 记 its meaning 'to record, remember.'
入 (enter, put away) — 全 pictures something being placed into safekeeping.
玉 (jade) — a valuable treasure kept whole and undamaged, giving 全 its meaning of 'complete' or 'entire.'
身 depicts a person's torso, originally showing a pregnant woman's body — later broadened to mean 'the body' in general.

meanings: dedicated (to a particular field or purpose)

components.note: 门 is a picture of a double-leafed door or gate, drawn symmetrically to show two swinging panels.
夕 (evening, night) — divination was traditionally done in the evening.
卜 (to divine, reading cracks in bone or shell) — combined with 夕 (evening), an evening divination was for unusual or 'outside' matters, giving 外 its meaning of 'outside' or 'foreign.'
禾 (grain, a rice/wheat plant) — 科 relates to sorting and measuring crops.
斗 (a measuring ladle) — measuring grain into ordered categories gave 科 its meaning 'a branch of study' or 'a department.'
钅 (metal) shows 钢 names a type of metal.
冈 (gāng) gives the exact sound of 钢.
玨 (two connected jade pieces, representing strings) at the top shows the instrument's strings.
今 at the bottom rounds out the character's shape, giving 琴 its meaning 'a stringed instrument.'
人 (people) over 云 (clouds/say) — a picture of people gathering and speaking together, related to 会's meanings 'to meet' and 'to know how to.'
面 was originally a pictograph of a human face, with an outline around an eye — later broadening to mean 'face, surface, side.'
女 depicts a kneeling figure with arms crossed, a traditional posture — a simple picture of a woman.
良 (good) — 郎 originally described a fine, well-regarded man.
阝 (a settlement, a place) — a good man 良 from a certain place 阝 gave 郎 its meaning 'a young man, a gentleman.'
亻 (a person) — the one repeating the routine.
日 (day, sun) — going somewhere every day, a repeated routine giving 复 its meaning 'to repeat, return; again.'
亻 (person) — 仇 describes a person one holds a grudge against, 'an enemy.'
九 (jiǔ) is only distantly related in sound to chóu — the connection has drifted apart over time.
攵 (a hand with a stick, action) — 数 relates to the action of counting.
娄 (lóu) gives a hint of the sound — 数 is pronounced shù, a connection that has drifted over time.
冖 (a covering/roof) — represents the building or schoolhouse where learning happens.
子 (child) — 学 depicts children gathered to study.
⺍ is a small graphic element at the top of the character; its original pictorial meaning, if any, has been lost over time.

meanings: to go so far as to

components.note: 至 depicts an arrow reaching the ground after landing — arriving at a destination gave 至 its meaning 'to arrive' or 'until.'
⺮ (bamboo) — 篮 names an object often woven from bamboo, a basket.
监 (jiān) gives a sound only distantly related to lán today, having drifted apart over time.
王 (a variant of 玉, meaning jade) — 球 originally referred to a round piece of jade, extended to mean 'ball, sphere'
求 (qiú) gives the sound — 球 is also pronounced qiú, an exact match
癶 (two feet) — 登 relates to climbing or ascending with one's legs
豆 (dòu) gives a sound distantly related to 登's reading dēng, having drifted apart over time
讠 (speech/writing) — the act of putting words down.
己 (oneself, private) — writing down one's own private notes or memories, giving 记 its meaning 'to record, remember.'
扌 (hand) — 指 relates to using the hand, specifically the fingers.
旨 (an aim, purpose) — combined with 扌 (hand), 指 came to mean 'finger' and 'to point,' aiming the hand at something.
寸 (a hand) — guiding the way.
巳 (a place) — the destination being pointed toward, giving 导 its meaning 'to lead, guide, direct.'
讠 (speech) — 诊 describes a doctor asking questions and speaking with a patient to diagnose an illness.
㐱 (zhěn) gives the sound — an exact match with 诊.
户 (door) — 所 evokes a location or place, such as where a door stands.
斤 (axe) — combined with 户 (door), the image of an axe at a door gave rise to the abstract sense of 'a place' or 'that which.'

meanings: (of a contagious disease etc) to spread
(of a style of clothing, song etc) popular

components.note: 氵 (water) — relates directly to 流's meaning 'to flow.'
㐬 (liú) gives the sound — 流 is also pronounced liú, an exact match.
彳 depicts a step with the left foot; together with 亍 (a step with the right foot), 行 shows a person walking or moving.
亍 depicts a step with the right foot, complementing 彳 to form the idea of walking or travel.

meanings: (fig.) person who has the potential to do the job

才 (cái) gives the sound — an exact match with 材.
米 (rice) — the grain being measured.
斗 (a measuring ladle) — measuring out rice gave 料 its meaning 'material, to estimate, to reckon.'
扌 (hand) shows 揭 relates to an action done by hand, like lifting a cover off.
曷 (hé) gives a sound distantly related to jiē, having drifted apart over time.
日 (sun) — 晓 describes the sun coming up, dawn, and by extension, becoming clear.
尧 (yáo) gives a sound close to xiǎo.
The oracle-bone form has been interpreted as a bird flying up toward the sky; the meaning later shifted entirely to represent negation, 'not.'
宀 (a roof, house) — 安 pictures shelter.
女 (woman) — a woman safely inside a house gave 安 its meaning 'peace' or 'safety.'
日 (sun) at the bottom shows the sun low in the sky.
氏 above suggests the sun dipping out of sight, giving 昏 its meaning 'dusk, growing dark.'
辶 (to walk) — 迷 originally described losing one's way while walking, extending to 'confused, obsessed.'
米 (mǐ) gives a sound distantly related to mí, having drifted apart over time.

邦 (a nation/state) — a community bound together

夕 (evening/night) — the darkness that has fallen
亻 (a person) — someone moving under cover of night
木 (tree) — 相 pictures looking closely at a tree.
目 (eye) — staring closely at a tree to examine it gave 相 the meaning 'to observe' or, later, 'each other, mutual.'

木 (wood) — 材 originally named timber.
才 (cái) gives the sound — an exact match with 材.
讠 (speech) — 讽 relates to speaking, in this case mocking through words.
风 (fēng) gives a sound close to fěng, sharing the same initial and rhyme with a different tone.
刂 (knife) — 刺 describes the action of piercing or stabbing with something sharp.
朿 (cì) gives the sound — an exact match with 刺's reading cì.
Ice — related to the character's early sense of cold.
Gives the sound líng, matching the character's reading.
日 (sun) — 晨 describes the time when the sun first rises, 'early morning.'
辰 (chén) gives the sound — an exact match with 晨.
氵 (water) — 海 relates to bodies of water, specifically the sea.
每 (měi) gives a hint of the sound — 海 is pronounced hǎi, a connection that has shifted over time.
山 (mountain) forms the top of the character.
厂 depicts a cliff or overhang — combined with 山 above, suggesting the steep edge of land meeting water, giving 岸 its meaning 'bank, shore.'
亚 (here a stylized shape related to advancing in rank) sits above.
日 (sun, day) below anchors the meaning in time, giving 晋 its sense 'to advance, to promote.'
纟 (thread) — 级 originally named a strand or rank of silk thread, extended to 'grade, level, rank.'
及 (jí) gives the sound — 级 is also pronounced jí, an exact match.
十 (here a straight vertical line) — 直 pictures something drawn perfectly straight.
目 (eye) — looking directly and steadily with the eye gave 直 its meaning 'straight' or 'direct.'
见 (to see, perceive) — relates to 觉's meaning 'to feel, sense, perceive.'
⺍ is a small graphic element serving as the phonetic hint, though its link to jué's modern sound has faded after centuries of change.
亻 (person) plus 乍 (suddenly/for the first time) — together suggesting a person making or doing something for the first time.
屮 (a young sprout) growing up and out of 凵 (a container or pit) — a picture of something emerging, hence 'going out.'
亻 (person) — 保 relates to a person looking after or protecting someone, originally a caretaker holding a child.
呆 (dāi) gives a hint of the sound — 保 is pronounced bǎo, a connection that has shifted over time.
罒 (net) — relates to 罗's original meaning 'net for catching birds,' extended to 'to gather, collect' and used today as a common Chinese surname.
